parsed.objective_technical_problem: Preventing cryogenic thermal shock-induced surface cracking in food by mitigating rapid pressure transients at the food-gas interface during immersion freezing

parsed.non_obvious_reason: The use of a micro-perforated sacrificial shell to geometrically mediate thermal shock via localized vapor cushioning and energy dissipation is not an obvious extension of prior art focused on monitoring, control, or material changes.
